_comment: Reference model matrix, August 2026. Verify exact API ids against each provider's current docs before a run — model names churn. Each entry: how to reach it. Use a strong `attacker`/`verifier`, and set `target` to whatever you are AUTHORIZED to assess.

anthropic.note: Anthropic's own endpoint is not OpenAI-shaped; reach Claude through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (LiteLLM/OpenRouter) or the Anthropic SDK. Example ids seen Aug 2026: claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5.

open_weight_via_ollama.note: Run `ollama serve`, then `ollama pull <tag>`. Any key value works locally. Tags seen Aug 2026 below.

open_weight_via_hosted.note: Together, Groq, Fireworks, OpenRouter all expose OpenAI-compatible endpoints for open-weight models.
